title: Distributional Conformal Prediction for Markov Processes
summary: We introduce the Markov Distributional Conformal Prediction (MDCP) method that extends the distributional conformal prediction (previously developed for regression) to the setting of a strictly stationary Markov process. Instead of relying on a specific model structure to do prediction, the idea of distributional conformal prediction interval aligns with the Model-Free (MF) Prediction Principle.
